subject: Roadmap trigger: QuantumPay entitlements and residency guardrails
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Product Team <product@redwood.com>, Eng Core <eng-core@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Roadmap trigger: QuantumPay entitlements and residency guardrails

Hi team,

Quick background: QuantumPay is moving from pilot to a 3-region production rollout. Legal & security have signed off on commercial terms contingent on two platform commitments in our SOW: (1) tenant-level residency controls (country/regional data residency) and (2) customer-managed key (CMK) for encryption of persisted telemetry exports.

QuantumPay has signaled willingness to sign this week if we can commit to a delivery milestone: staged delivery (MVP) by 2028-08-20 with a rollback-safe opt-in for the first 90 days. The contract and SOW are attached (QuantumPay_MVP_SOW.pdf) and I posted the HubSpot deal (link in metadata).

What I need from Product/Eng:
- Feasibility check: can residency controls + CMK support for telemetry exports be scoped into an MVP delivery by 2028-08-20 without blocking other active sprint commitments?
- Suggested implementation approach and minimal acceptance criteria we can give Legal/Customer for the SOW milestone.
- Risk & uplift estimate (engineering weeks) and a fallback plan if full CMK takes longer (e.g., encrypted exports + contract-level warranty).

Why priority: this is a seeded enterprise ARR expansion (>$1.2M ARR committed over 24 months). If we miss the date, QuantumPay has a clause to pause credits and push an alternative provider evaluation.

Notes: Customer asked specifically for audit evidence that telemetry exports can be restricted per tenant; they will receive weekly export snapshots (CSV) to their S3 with a customer KMS policy. Engineering should assume we must not duplicate plaintext customer PII in logs or exports.

Priyom — can you add this to the mutual action plan with sales milestone dates?
Karthik/Marissa — please acknowledge feasibility and call out any blocking dependencies by EOD Wed (2028-07-11).

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Product Team <product@redwood.com>, Eng Core <eng-core@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap trigger: QuantumPay entitlements and residency guardrails

Monica — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW.

Short answer: technically doable but tight. High-level notes after a quick triage:

1) Residency controls (tenant-level routing / storage zoning)
- We have a routing-policy framework but it requires work to support per-tenant region tags propagating through the router + exporter. Estimate: 2 engineering sprints (4 dev-weeks + integration/test).

2) CMK for telemetry exports
- CMK-backed S3 put is straightforward at export time if we reuse the existing KMS integration. The complexity is key rotation policy and customer KMS handshake (audit & IAM). Estimate: 1 sprint for basic support, +1 sprint to harden rotation/audit flows.

3) Audit evidence and proof-of-export isolation
- We can provide export proof by implementing per-export manifest fingerprints and signed notifications. Minor infra work: ~1 dev-week.

Cumulative: optimistic ~6 dev-weeks (3 sprints) if we can dedicate a small feature team; conservative ~10 dev-weeks with QA and ops gating.

Fallbacks:
- Phase 1: Residency routing + encrypted export using our managed KMS (no CMK) with a contractual SLA and data-handling attestation.
- Phase 2: CMK handshake + rotation in Sprint 3.

Blocks/Deps:
- Needs product acceptance criteria and legal buy-in on phased approach.
- Platform infra must prioritize an on-call runbook for export failures.
- Security needs to sign off on key-handshake design (I'll loop them once we have a proposed flow).

Marissa — can you sanity-check the dev estimates and call out any non-obvious infra work?
Priyom — please confirm the customer is comfortable with the phased plan; if not we need to treat CMK as a hard requirement.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
VP, Product Management | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Eng Core <eng-core@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap trigger: QuantumPay entitlements and residency guardrails

Thanks for the quick triage — adding engineering perspective and a proposed minimal plan.

Tech assumptions (call these out if they differ):
- Exports pipeline currently writes to an internal staging bucket before dispatch; we'll add tenant tag propagation to that manifest.
- KMS integration exists for internal backups; customer CMK means adding the option to SetObject with customer-key-id on export writes.

Proposed 3-week MVP path (aggressive, requires dedicated pairing):
Week 1 (sprint A):
- Add tenant region tag propagation across request -> exporter (~2 dev days).
- Implement export manifest with per-export fingerprint and signed notification (~3 dev days).
- Deliver: signed export notification sample and manifest schema for customer review.

Week 2 (sprint B):
- Add S3 export option to call SetObject with provided customer KMS key (config by tenant). Add unit/integration tests (~4 dev days).
- Smoke test with internal KMS on staging.

Week 3 (sprint B cont / sprint C start):
- Harden rotation & failure rollback flows; implement basic ops runbook and metric alerts (~4 dev days).
- Prepare compliance evidence bundle (steps + screenshots) and define acceptance criteria.

Deliverables by 2028-08-20 (if we staff a 2-3 engineer feature pod):
- Tenant-region export manifests (evidence).
- S3 export with customer KMS settable per tenant (basic rotation policy).
- Compliance evidence bundle and runbook.

Tradeoffs & caveats:
- We will not ship full CMK lifecycle UI (key import/rotate) in MVP — that’s Phase 2.
- This path adds ~0.5% infra cost on exports and requires a short freeze window for exporter config rollout.

If Sales needs the hard CMK lifecycle for contract signing, mark that as an acceptance criteria and we’ll push the timeline by 2 additional weeks.

Action items:
- Monica/Priyom: confirm whether Phase 1 (managed KMS with contract warranty) is acceptable to QuantumPay.
- Karthik: start PLA ticket to schedule security review for the KMS handshake.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Software Engineering Manager, Platform
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@quantumpay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@quantumpay.com>, QuantumPay Contracts <quantumpay-contracts@docsend.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap trigger: QuantumPay entitlements and residency guardrails

Hi Monica / team — thanks for the responsiveness and the proposed plan.

QuantumPay is comfortable with a phased delivery as long as the SOW milestone is explicit:
- Phase 1 (by 2028-08-20): per-tenant region export + encrypted S3 delivery using Redwood-managed KMS and a weekly signed export manifest (we will accept a contractual clause while you ship CMK lifecycle).
- Phase 2 (target by 2028-09-17): CMK handshake + key rotation automation.

We will add a short schedule margin in the SOW to accommodate a security review and minor integration testing. Sanjay and I will update the DocSend SOW with the phased milestones and sign once we get an email confirmation thread from Redwood with the acceptance criteria.

Please confirm by COB Monday 2028-07-17 and we’ll move to countersign.

Best,
Priya
